prompts: Add a timestamp parameter to logfmt_format so the output looks like key=val ts=<timestamp>
Add a logfmt_len function that returns the length the formatted string would need
Support quoted values in logfmt_parse: if val starts with a double-quote, read until closing quote
Add a logfmt_copy_upper variant that copies src to dst converting to uppercase
Refactor logfmt_format to use an internal helper _write_pair(out, out_sz, k, v)
Add logfmt_append(char *buf, size_t buf_sz, const char *key, const char *val) that appends key=val after existing content
Reduce memory: change logfmt_copy to return early without writing if src fits exactly in dst_sz
Add logfmt_parse_multi that parses k1=v1 k2=v2 into arrays of keys and values
